compatibility_notes: Designed for Rain Bird U-Series, HE-VAN, R-VAN, MPR, VAN, and XPCN plastic spray head nozzles.
installation_constraints: Side and bottom inlets are provided.
notes: 12 inch pop-up height and 16 inch body height. Flow-by is 0 gpm at 8 psi or greater and 0.1 gpm otherwise. The spray body has no independent nozzle performance table; radius, flow, and precipitation depend on the installed nozzle.
